pages.text: The thorn follows the next marker. The ember gives the part of the reading the needle cannot: height. Above the needle means higher ground; below it means a lower passage.
pages.title: The compass
Reading the ember
pages.text: Hold use to take a steadier reading. The ember and chime rise or fall together. Release when you have your bearing.

pages.title: A bearing, not a path
pages.text: A needle pointing into a cliff has not found a tunnel. Look for a route around or beneath it; the instrument cannot choose your footing.

pages.title: A bearing, not a path
pages.text: After the checkpoints, it points to extraction. The terminal recalls this compass when the expedition ends. Keep your own equipment separate from what the charter lends.
